description: This file contains utility functions for number formatting, including trimming zeros, counting digits, rounding to significant digits, and converting to scientific notation, within the NumberFormattingUtils namespace.

methods.name: TrimTrailingZeros
methods.description: Removes trailing zeros and decimal point from a string representing a number.

methods.name: GetNumberDigits
methods.description: Returns the total number of significant digits in a string representation of a number, excluding trailing zeros and signs.

methods.name: GetNumberDigitsWholeNumberPart
methods.description: Calculates the number of digits in the whole number part of a double value.

methods.name: RoundSignificantDigits
methods.description: Rounds a double to a specified number of significant digits and returns it as a string.

methods.name: ToScientificNumber
methods.description: Converts a double to its scientific notation string representation.
